content.title: Chapter 62 - OFFENSES — Sec. 62-91. - Legislative declaration.
content.summary:
The city council declares that it is necessary to standardize the management of property
               and evidence coming into possession of the city, to provide for the efficient processing
               of such property, and to promote the efficient return of property to its owner.
